seed_data_creation: Test employees and guides created during testing with TEST_ prefix. Some emitted guides remain in DB (cannot be deleted once emitted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Transport Guides module fully tested and working. Key verified flows: (1) POST /api/employees/{id}/set-password - admin sets password for employee with email, rejects if no email or password < 4 chars, (2) POST /api/tech/auth/login - tech login with email+password, returns access_token type='tech', rejects inactive with 403, (3) GET /api/tech/auth/me - returns employee data without password_hash, (4) POST /api/transport-guides - creates guide with auto-numbering GT YYYY/NNNN, status=rascunho, requires items>=1, (5) GET /api/transport-guides with filters status/work_id/employee_id, (6) PUT /api/transport-guides/{id} - updates fields, regenerates item IDs, blocked if status=recebida, (7) DELETE /api/transport-guides/{id} - only allowed for rascunho, (8) POST /api/transport-guides/{id}/emit - requires assigned_employee_id, decrements stock_current, creates stock_movements type='saida', sets status=emitida, (9) GET /api/tech/transport-guides - tech sees only assigned guides with status in [emitida, em_transito, recebida, recebida_com_diferencas], (10) GET /api/tech/transport-guides/{id} - 404 if not assigned to tech, (11) POST /api/tech/transport-guides/{id}/receive - updates qty_received/damaged_qty, creates stock_movement type='perda' if shortfall, sets status=recebida or recebida_com_diferencas, stores signature_data/photos/signed_by_name, blocked if already received, (12) GET /api/transport-guides/_helpers/work-materials/{work_id} - returns budget items + extras. Frontend: GuiasPage with filter buttons (all/rascunho/emitida/recebida/c_diferencas), Nova Guia dialog with work/manual modes, select work loads budget items, select employee dropdown, save draft or create+emit buttons, detail dialog shows items table with qty_prevista/qty_recebida/danificado columns, reception section with signature, history timeline, PDF download. FuncionariosPage: KeyRound button opens set-password dialog with employee name/email, password input, save button.
